When SWIRL crashes, hangs or shows warnings, it draws a report as QR codes on the TV. Scan them with your phone and paste the text here, or drop photos of the screen. Card Manager decodes the report on this PC and writes the text for a GitHub issue. Nothing is sent anywhere by itself.

On the Dreamcast: System, Diagnostics, press A for the report at any time. After a crash or a hang the report is already on the screen. Hold X while turning the console on for the start up log. Several codes take turns; scan each one, in any order.
Drop photos of the QR codes here, or click to choose them. A screenshot from an emulator works too. The build's themeMenu.elf can be dropped here as well, to name the addresses of a crash.
Or paste the text your phone's QR scanner read, every part, in any order. Each part starts with a line like SWIRL 2.14 1/3.

Every game boots region free and in VGA, with nothing changed on the card. To set one game differently, open it on the Dreamcast and press X for Options: Region (game default, Japan, USA, Europe), Video (Force VGA or game default) and Boot (straight in, boot animation, SEGA screen). The choice is saved for that game.

Games with no VGA mode. A few games (Hydro Thunder is one) have no VGA output of their own: over a VGA cable they reach the SEGA screen and then the display shows nothing. Card Manager carries community patches that add VGA to those games and can apply them in place, with an undo. Tell it how your Dreamcast is connected:
VGA cable: patch these games for me automatically
TV (composite, S-Video, RGB SCART): leave games as they are
